meta.revisionPolicy: Section 42 figures are provisional, then final; sectoral credit is provisional and revised the next month; NPAs and capital ratios are final on release. Seams disclosed, never joined: the 2019 sectoral classification, the July 2023 HDFC merger, the December 2025 reporting calendar.
meta.base: RBI Report on Trend and Progress of Banking in India
meta.coverage: State co-operative agriculture and rural development banks by region: branches, loans, recovery and profit, each year
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 1538 (data provider DP0), read from the local Data Bank mirror, as published. Final figures where published, else provisional. Amounts in ₹ crore; counts as numbers; ratios in per cent, as each row's label says. Branch counts are stored in the mirror multiplied by 100,000 (789 branches as 78,900,000); divided back, every one is a whole number.
